snippet.title: First Hero - Epic of Gilgamesh Official Trailer
snippet.description:
"First Hero - Epic of Gilgamesh" is an independent third person hack and slash game, based on the adventures of the demigod,
collected in the most ancient epic of human memory. Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379610/First_Hero__Epic_of_Gilgamesh/


Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/firstheroepic/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/firstheroepic/
Website: https://www.firstherogame.com/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379610/First_Hero__Epic_of_Gilgamesh/
